game.title: Bayonetta 3
game.notes: Genesis Mode — Bayonetta 3 is a Nintendo Switch console exclusive; no other platform release exists (Nintendo funded development, as with Bayonetta 2), so there is no native achievement list to port. No DLC of any kind was ever released, confirmed via the complete official patch history (v1.0.0-v1.2.0). No content is permanently missable — every chapter, side mission, and secret chapter remains replayable via Chapter Select indefinitely. Per user confirmation at the dossier checkpoint, the Non-Stop ∞ Climax difficulty trophy was deliberately scoped to 'unlock the difficulty' rather than 'clear the full campaign on it,' because difficulty can be freely switched per chapter from the Chapter Select menu and no source confirms the game records a per-chapter 'cleared on hardest difficulty' flag — a full-campaign-on-hardest trophy could not be verified as genuine rather than gamed (Rule 11). Since the difficulty unlocks automatically the moment the story is finished on any difficulty, it would be redundant with the story-completion trophy (BAY3-024), so no separate trophy was created for it at all. Also per checkpoint confirmation, Card Packs (41, medium confidence) and Figure Boxes (total disputed between 43 and 46 across sources) have no in-game numeric or percentage tracker of any kind — only individual finds are confirmed visible via new Gallery art — so only bronze 'first find' trophies were built for these, with no 'collect them all' trophy that would rely on a disputed number and an unconfirmed aggregate tracker. An earlier research pass wrongly flagged Medallion Shards/the Golem secret boss as fabricated; this was independently re-confirmed as real by 6+ sources across two later passes and is included at full confidence. The Chapter 14 final boss's true identity is left unnamed in trophy text (Rule 16) to avoid spoiling the story's central twist. An audit pass caught a dossier error: Jeanne does NOT become playable through the 14 main story chapters after unlocking her post-game — she remains restricted to her own Side Missions, Phenomenal Remnant chapters, Witch Trials, and secret chapters; BAY3-022 was corrected accordingly. Umbran Tears of Blood are caught, not defeated in combat (BAY3-006 corrected), and the 14th Phenomenal Remnant unlocks via story completion rather than tear collection like the other 13 (BAY3-021 corrected). BAY3-025 was added to represent the Demon Slave giant-demon combat sequences, one of the game's most identity-defining systems, which the original draft omitted entirely.

trophies.name: Kraken Conquered
trophies.description: Defeat Kraken in the Prologue: A Chaotic Encounter.
trophies.verification: The Prologue: A Chaotic Encounter is marked cleared on the Chapter Select screen.

trophies.name: Answers Found
trophies.description: Clear Chapter 1: Scrambling for Answers.
trophies.verification: Chapter 1 is marked cleared on the Chapter Select screen.

trophies.name: Dance of Death
trophies.description: Trigger Witch Time as Bayonetta for the first time, by dodging an attack at the last moment.
trophies.verification: A successful last-second dodge visibly triggers the slow-motion Witch Time effect on-screen.

trophies.name: A Different Rhythm
trophies.description: Trigger Witch Time as Viola for the first time, using her parry.
trophies.verification: A successful parry visibly triggers the slow-motion Witch Time effect while playing as Viola.

trophies.name: Rodin's Regular
trophies.description: Purchase a costume from Rodin's Treasures.
trophies.verification: The purchased costume appears as owned in the Costumes tab of the pause menu.

trophies.name: Blood Debt
trophies.description: Collect your first Umbran Tear of Blood.
trophies.verification: The tear is added after catching the familiar carrying it, contributing toward that chapter's Phenomenal Remnant unlock progress.

trophies.name: Trial and Error
trophies.description: Obtain your first Bewitchment.
trophies.verification: The Chapter Select screen's per-chapter Bewitchment checklist shows one objective as obtained.

trophies.name: Snapshot
trophies.description: Find your first Card Pack.
trophies.verification: New illustrated art appears in the Gallery menu after finding a Card Pack.

trophies.name: On Display
trophies.description: Find your first Figure Box.
trophies.verification: New behind-the-scenes art appears in the Gallery menu after finding a Figure Box.

trophies.name: Spy Games
trophies.description: Complete your first Jeanne Side Mission.
trophies.verification: The Side Mission is marked cleared on its select screen.

trophies.name: Flawless Verse
trophies.description: Earn a Pure Platinum medal on any Verse.
trophies.verification: The post-Verse results screen displays a Pure Platinum medal.

trophies.name: Remnant Unearthed
trophies.description: Unlock your first Phenomenal Remnant by collecting all 3 Umbran Tears of Blood in a chapter.
trophies.verification: A red icon appears on that chapter's Chapter Select entry, and its Phenomenal Remnant stage becomes selectable.

trophies.name: Chapter Cleared
trophies.description: Obtain every Bewitchment in any single main chapter.
trophies.verification: That chapter's Bewitchment checklist on the Chapter Select screen shows all 5 objectives obtained.

trophies.name: Legacy of the Witch
trophies.description: Unlock and equip a legacy costume referencing the original Bayonetta or Bayonetta 2.
trophies.verification: The legacy costume is equipped and visible on Bayonetta during a course.

trophies.name: Full Report
trophies.description: Complete all four of Jeanne's Side Missions.
trophies.verification: All four Side Missions show as cleared on their select screen.

trophies.name: Storm's Eye
trophies.description: Defeat Stratocumulus to complete Chapter 9: Learning to Fly.
trophies.verification: Chapter 9 is marked cleared on the Chapter Select screen.

trophies.name: Clockwork Witch
trophies.description: Defeat the Umbran Clock Tower to complete Chapter 11: A Familiar Dance.
trophies.verification: Chapter 11 is marked cleared on the Chapter Select screen.

trophies.name: Curtain Call
trophies.description: Defeat Baal Zebul's rhythm showdown to complete Chapter 12: The Edge of Madness.
trophies.verification: Chapter 12 is marked cleared on the Chapter Select screen.

trophies.name: Trial by Fire
trophies.description: Clear all three Witch Trials.
trophies.verification: All three Witch Trial reward shirts appear in the Costumes tab.

trophies.name: Golem's Reckoning
trophies.description: Recover all four Medallion Shards and defeat Golem in the secret chapter, The Artifact Unleashed.
trophies.verification: A green icon appears on the Chapter Select map once all four shards are collected, and The Artifact Unleashed shows as cleared after defeating Golem.

trophies.name: Every Remnant
trophies.description: Unlock all 14 Phenomenal Remnants by collecting every Umbran Tear of Blood and completing the story.
trophies.verification: Every chapter entry on the Chapter Select screen shows its Phenomenal Remnant unlocked (red icon).

trophies.name: Jeanne Unbound
trophies.description: Unlock Jeanne after completing the story, then clear one of her playable chapters (a Side Mission, Phenomenal Remnant, or secret chapter) as her.
trophies.verification: One of Jeanne's playable chapters shows a completed results screen with her as the active character.

trophies.name: Toughest Fight in Hell
trophies.description: Spend a Platinum Ticket to challenge Rodin at full power.
trophies.verification: The results screen confirms a win against Devil Rodin after redeeming the Platinum Ticket.

trophies.name: Master of Ceremonies
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 14: The Single Truth and finish the story.
trophies.verification: Chapter 14 is marked cleared on the Chapter Select screen and the story's credits roll.

trophies.name: Titan's Call
trophies.description: Summon and fight as a full-scale Infernal Demon in a Demon Slave sequence for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Demon Slave transformation activates on-screen, replacing Bayonetta or Viola with the giant demon for the encounter.

trophies.name: The Umbra Witch's Legacy
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other trophies show as earned.
